sentences.text: Gurilynia is a genus of enantiornithine birds, a family known as Enantiornithidae.
This species reached a total length of 53 cm, a hip height of 23.2 cm, and weighed 2.1 kg.
The humeral head of its skeleton measures approximately 29 mm in width.
Its existence proves that large Enantiornithes lived in both Central Asia and the Americas.
Remains were uncovered at the Gurilyn Tsav locality within the Nemegt Formation of south Gobi, Mongolia, and are now kept at the Paleontological Institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences.
Only one species, Gurilynia nessovi, is recognized, and it serves as the type species for the genus.
The animal lived during the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous, spanning from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
